description: Generate a secure Paystack checkout link for upgrading to Pro (unlimited card views). This only creates the link; nothing is charged. Give the link to the user so they can review and pay in their browser. Only call this after the user has said they want to upgrade.

apiKey.description: KadiConnect API key (starts with kc_). Only needed when the MCP connection was not configured with an Authorization header, for example right after calling register.

name: get_upgrade_link
title: Get a Pro checkout link
